Which customers breached an XLA in the l.text:
Only Fabrikam Industries and Litware Insurance breached their zero‑touch XLAs last week; Fabrikam is owed 9,250 EUR, Litware gets a remediation plan but no credit. Fabrikam dropped from 46.0% to 34.0% zero‑touch against a 40.0% weekly target (clause: “credits 5% of the monthly service fee… within the monthly cap of 15%”). Litware also fell from 46.0% to 34.0% vs a 40.0% weekly target (“written remediation plan… No service credit applies”).

List every zero-touch XLA through (Custo.text:
We have five zero‑touch XLAs: four carry service credits, one is review‑only. Contoso Retail, Fabrikam Industries, Woodgrove Bank and Tailspin Airlines each get 2–5% of the monthly fee back if zero‑touch drops below a 30–40% threshold (“credits x% of the monthly service fee…”). Litware Insurance’s weekly XLA is purely remedial: below 40% only triggers “a written remediation plan… No service credit applies.”

### SOURCE
- ONT_ServiceDesk: Customer[customer_id, customer_name]
- ONT_ServiceDesk: Contract[contract_id, customer_id, penalty_cap_pct, monthly_fee_eur]
- ONT_ServiceDesk: Xla[metric='zero_touch_rate', comparator, threshold, measurement_window, penalty_pct, `unit`, clause_text]
- ONT_ServiceDesk: (Customer)-[:CustomerHasContract]->(Contract)-[:ContractDefinesXla]->(Xla)
